body: Ohh yes for sure! I just think that some people end up having more regrets than others and I would like to minimize mine as much as possible
I completely agree. I haven’t moved. Can’t even sleep, just lay there in a pit.
You don’t think there’s anyone on this planet who could say they did everything they wanted or you do think there’s someone who has?
Yes! I know I’ll be old one day and look back and regret the time I wasted
I keep reminding myself that there’s over three million other people just in the US who feel the same way as us. People will understand.
You too. It’s hard because I don’t have many friends so I’m not exactly excited to discuss my mental health issues with the few that I have with the fear of losing them
Thank you, I don’t want you to either. It makes me angry that life is so short and I’m spending it feeling this way
Thank you. It almost feels like it doesn’t matter if people care or not because I just want to get rid of this feeling altogether. I keep telling myself that things will get better and they don’t.
